actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Tango Card action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Tango Card connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_order
actions.title: Create order
actions.description: Create an order in Tango Card

actions.name: get_account
actions.title: Get account details by ID
actions.description: Get account by ID in Tango Card
actions.help: Get details of a specific account in Tango Card

actions.name: resend_order
actions.title: Resend order
actions.description: Resend an order in Tango Card
actions.help: Resend a specific order in Tango Card.

input.name: newEmail
input.label: New email
input.hint: A new email address to resend this order to.

actions.name: search_orders
actions.title: Search orders
actions.help: Retrieve the list of orders that match your criteria

input.name: externalRefID
input.label: External Reference ID
input.hint: Filters orders by external reference ID.

input.name: elementsPerBlock
input.label: Page size
input.hint: The number of records to fetch.

input.name: page
input.label: Page number
input.hint: Used for pagination. The page number of results to fetch
